notes:
New: Keys tab in the CAFD editor. Open your key list (KEYLIST.xml), see only the keys the open file has, pick or type values and apply them all at once, with Undo.
New: Script tab in the FDL editor. Paste settings as text, one per line (NAME=werte=01), or open a .txt or .csr script. Each line is checked against the open file, then Apply sets them all at once, with Undo.
Big scripts apply in about a second, even with 1,000+ settings.
Choose which PSdZData each E-Sys loads: press Change beside PSdZData on Home.
Service functions and Service reset no longer need E-Sys closed. Only when E-Sys is connected to the car, press Disconnect in E-Sys first.
Updating only asks you to close an E-Sys that E-Sys MAX opened.
Cleaner Settings page with the E-Sys shortcuts as key tiles.
Many fixes and safety improvements. This update is required.
